title: e2e-full-battery.sh section-8 wait hang in coexist mode — step times out, trap skipped, agents leak
foreman_note: Filed tick #216 after CI run 30903388351: coexist battery passed sections 1-7a (all on isolated :29091/:28081, own daemon), then hung at section 8 'Multi-agent Spawn' bare `wait`. Server-side ALL 5 spawns succeeded by 11:12:22Z (bunkerd-battery.log: 'agent spawned successfully' x5, incl. e2e-agent-5), but the step printed nothing after the section-8 header and was killed at the 15-min timeout (11:27:06Z). GH killing the process tree skipped the EXIT trap → 5 battery agents (e2e-main + e2e-agent-2..5) left as users. CLI spawn ctx is 30s (spawn.go:64), so a 15-min hang means the block is OUTSIDE the RPC — unknown: candidate is `wait` waiting on a background job that never exits (4 parallel `$BUNKER spawn ... &`), possibly config/key-file contention on the shared temp HOME. Fix direction: bounded wait (timeout per spawn / wait with timeout) so the trap always runs + diagnose the CLI exit path. Verify: battery completes with VERIFY-PASS, 0 leaked users after run.
